main.description: Create a Stripe Express connected account for Mode B revenue-share tenants and return an account_links onboarding URL. Persists stripe_connect_account_id + billing_mode='rev_share_y1' + platform_fee_pct=85 to vertex_lawfirm_tenant. Sub-tenant subscriptions split via application_fee_percent + transfer_data[destination].

returnOrigin.description: Origin used to build refresh + return URL (defaults to https://<tenantId>.lawfirm.gftd.ai)

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Required field missing or country !~ ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

errors.name: RegionUnsupported
errors.description: Stripe Connect Express not available in country

errors.name: StripeApiError
errors.description: Stripe API call returned an error
